event.dorian_heart2.0.text: Shh. Stop. Stand in my footprints. Look.
event.dorian_heart2.0.why: footprints are more specific and intimate than a spot

event.dorian_heart2.3.text: Three breaths, she stayed. Foxes give you one. You stand like a tree.
event.dorian_heart2.3.why: he counts; a number makes the compliment earned

event.dorian_heart2.2.text: These grew where she watched you. Take them. Not me. The forest.
event.dorian_heart2.2.why: ties the gift to the fox; keeps the catchphrase

event.dorian_heart2.4.text: There's another place. Deeper in. Not yet. The moss is still deciding.
event.dorian_heart2.4.why: echoes the fox deciding; the thread gets a gatekeeper

event.dorian_heart5.0.text: Step over the root. Not on the moss. This is my spot.
event.dorian_heart5.0.why: care for the moss shows the spot matters before he says so

event.dorian_heart5.1.text: I've never shown anyone. Edmund found it alone. I didn't mind. Odd.
event.dorian_heart5.1.why: his own surprise at not minding says more than the fact

event.dorian_heart5.2.text: Tell nobody. Not even Marcus. The truffle under the oak is yours.
event.dorian_heart5.2.why: naming Marcus makes the secrecy concrete

event.reading_night.2.text: A snowdrop. Pressed since winter. It kept my place. Now it keeps the lamp.
event.reading_night.2.why: answers Hazel's lamp poem without saying so; snowdrop and lamp kept for Ione's echo

event.story_notes_dorian.intro.text: Oh. ...The note was meant to do this part alone. Paper doesn't look back.
event.story_notes_dorian.intro.why: names his fear of being looked at without explaining it

dlg.story.notes.dorian.c0.why: matches r0 and the attitude it rewards

dlg.story.notes.dorian.r1.text: ...Don't mention it. Truly. Don't. I'll be behind a tree.
dlg.story.notes.dorian.r1.why: he deflects thanks like he deflects the offerings; literalism lands

dlg.story.scarecrow.talk.1.text: Mine just stands there. Silent. Crows hate silence. I took notes.
dlg.story.scarecrow.talk.1.why: the scarecrow is him; notes nod at the notebook habit

dlg.story.scarecrow.talk.r1.text: ...Mine. Oh. ...Take the runner-up home. We're both embarrassed now.

dlg.story.scarecrow.talk.r3.text: The crows voted already. Four sat on each. A tie. Take one.
dlg.story.scarecrow.talk.r3.why: he counted the crows; deadpan field data

event.story_pumpkin_dorian.intro.text: ...The inside was the right dark. For spores. Asking needed words. I ran out.
event.story_pumpkin_dorian.intro.why: mushroom logic plus the real confession: words ran out

dlg.story.pumpkin.dorian.0.text: Behind the store, the prize pumpkin. Dorian stands beside it, very still.
dlg.story.pumpkin.dorian.0.why: stillness is funnier than a guilty face and is what the sprite shows

dlg.story.pumpkin.dorian.2.text: ...Borrowed. The mushrooms needed a roof. It was coming back. Mostly.

event.dorian_heart8.intro.text: Sit. The log. ...I practiced this part. Don't speak yet.
event.dorian_heart8.intro.why: he rehearsed showing the notebook; the effort is the feeling

dlg.dorian.notebook.1.text: Mushrooms. Four hundred and twelve. Drawn. Nobody's seen them. ...Be gentle.
dlg.dorian.notebook.1.why: an exact count makes hundreds true and him truer

event.dorian_birthday.intro.text: ...My birthday. Marcus told the whole saloon. The trees won't mention it. Stay a minute. Not long.
event.dorian_birthday.intro.why: the trees keep his secret; saloon is specific

dlg.dorian.birthday.r1.text: Good. The moss past the second ridge. It's waited all year.
dlg.dorian.birthday.r1.why: a place with a direction; 'waited all year' is birthday-sized

event.dorian_courtship.intro.text: ...I've practiced this since spring. The trees heard it first. Will you court me? Slowly. Here. Quietly.
event.dorian_courtship.intro.why: a season of rehearsal to trees says what the question costs

dlg.dorian.courtship.r0.text: ...Yes. ...I asked the oak how to say it. It didn't help. All the quiet places are yours.
dlg.dorian.courtship.r0.why: self-deprecating relief; the gift lands last

event.dorian_courtship2.intro.text: ...You said wait. The oak and I practiced. Once more, then. Will you court me? Slowly. Quietly.
event.dorian_courtship2.intro.why: pays off 'ask any oak' from his own wait answer

event.dorian_partners.intro.text: I made this. A jay feather, willow, twine. It took three tries. Hold it.
event.dorian_partners.intro.why: 'three tries' is the love; the materials are named

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_1.l4.text: ...You could have. You saved it for me.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_1.l4.why: 'saved' is warmer than 'left'; Marcus leaves him room on purpose

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_1.l3.text: ...Quiet today. Even the jays are reading.
event.overheard_dorian_hazel_1.l3.why: forest literalism that hands Hazel her book line

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_2.l1.text: My old mushroom guide. Pressed leaves inside. Nine falls of them.
event.overheard_dorian_hazel_2.l1.why: 'nine falls' counts the years the way he would

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_3.l3.text: Then the trees can come too. They invented not talking.
event.overheard_dorian_hazel_3.l3.why: the joke credits the trees, his highest praise

threads.dorian_heart2: A deeper place exists, and the moss has not decided about the player yet.
threads.dorian_heart5: How far Edmund got counting the trees; Dorian never asked, and now nobody can.
threads.story_notes_dorian: Three more doors get notes before dark, and the player must not guess whose.
threads.story_pumpkin_dorian: Next fall Dorian grows his own pumpkin; the mushrooms still want a roof.
threads.dorian_heart8: The notebook's next page is promised: the player drawn as a mushroom, or a crooked page one kept forever.
threads.dorian_birthday: The thick moss past the second ridge has waited all year for a slower walk.
threads.dorian_courtship: Tomorrow's walk: no talking until the third tree, and maybe something after.
threads.dorian_courtship2: What the oak taught him while he waited, and how long he would have kept waiting.
threads.dorian_partners: The old oak past the third tree listens, and the feather was kept from the day they met.
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_1: Marcus leaves words unsaid on purpose so Dorian can have them.
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_2: Dorian budgets words by the week; what he spends the rest on goes unsaid.
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_3: The oak door will stay open, mostly; for whom is not said.
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_4: The owl at the new window has not told anyone its name yet.

notes: reading_night: kept 'snowdrop' and 'lamp' in my line because Ione's next line echoes both words.
dlg.dorian.notebook.1 now fixes the notebook at four hundred and twelve drawings; if anyone else ever counts them, use that number.
story_notes_dorian r1: replaced 'You're welcome' with a deflection — Dorian refuses thanks the way he refuses credit for the offerings.
dlg.dorian.courtship.* keys are shared by dorian_courtship and dorian_courtship2; my r0 rewrite lands in both, and it reads right in both.
heart5: Edmund stays strictly cozy ('found it alone', 'counting the trees'); please keep other villagers from explaining the counting.
